description: This file contains the implementation of the Language class within the Opencart System Library namespace. It manages language text strings, supporting operations such as adding paths, loading language files, and getting/setting language strings.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: A class for managing language strings, including loading language files, retrieving, setting, and listing language data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Language object with a language code.

methods.name: addPath
methods.description: Adds a new path for a namespace/directory mapping.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the language string associated with a given key.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a language string for a specified key.

methods.name: all
methods.description: Returns all language data, optionally filtered by a prefix.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all the loaded language data.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads language strings from a specified language file, supporting caching and namespace management.
